WineTahoma.ttf, WineTahomaBold.ttf: the 11 px (Tahoma 8 pt) bitmap strikes of Wine's Tahoma replacement fonts
(tahoma.ttf, tahomabd.ttf; Copyright (c) 2004 Larry Snyder, based on Bitstream Vera Sans (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc.;
GNU LGPL 2.1 or later; https://www.winehq.org), turned into pixel outlines with tools/strike2ttf.py. Source files
from Debian's fonts-wine 8.0 package. Pixel-exact at font size 11.
